mLocKeys.keySummary: Zeri dashes a short distance and energizes Burst Fire to pierce through enemies. She will vault and grind over any terrain she touches.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zeri dashes a short distance and vaults over any terrain she touches, greatly extending the dash range. For the next @BuffDuration@ seconds, her shots of {{Spell_ZeriQ_Name}} pierce dealing @PenDamagePercent*100@% damage to enemies after the first and an additional @BonusDamageTotal@ magic damage On-Hit to the first target struck.

Hitting an enemy with an Attack reduces this Ability's cooldown by @CDReductionPerHit@ seconds. Critical strikes reduce the cooldown by @CritCDReductionPerHit@ seconds instead.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
On-hit damage is increased by Zeri's Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at @CritScalingMod*100@% effectiveness.
Pierce damage can critically strike but does not apply On-Hit effects.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities. Moving and casting Burst Fire stores up energy in Zeri's Sparkpack. When fully charged her next Attack deals bonus damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zeri's Attacks are treated as Abilities instead of Attacks and can be charged up by moving and casting <spellName>{{Spell_ZeriQ_Name}}</spellName>. Uncharged Attacks consume a small amount of charge, deal <magicDamage>@Spell.ZeriQ:MinDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <danger>execute</danger> enemies below <attention>@Spell.ZeriQ:PassiveExecuteThreshold@ Health</attention>. A fully charged Attack deals <magicDamage>@Spell.ZeriQ:PassiveMaxDamage@ + @Spell.ZeriQ:PassiveMaxChargePercentHealth@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and consumes all charge.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_ZeriPassive_Tooltip}}

Percent Health damage against jungle monsters is capped at 300.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has stolen an enemy's shield.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zeri fires a burst of @NumberOfMissiles@ rounds that deals <physicalDamage>@ActiveDamageThatCanCrit@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability can crit, apply on-hit effects once per target, and hit anything that an Attack can. The Cooldown and cast time scale down with <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> (max <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeedCap@ attacks per second</attackSpeed>). @ExcessAttackSpeedToADMult*100@% of excess <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> is converted into <physicalDamage>Attack Damage</physicalDamage>.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zeri's next basic attack will deal bonus damage. ZAP!

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zeri discharges a nova of electricity, dealing @TotalActiveDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits an enemy champion, Zeri gains @BaseASPercent*100@% Attack Speed and @BaseBonusMS*100@% Move Speed for @RDuration@ seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability extends this ability's duration and adds a stack of Overcharge for @MaxHyperchargeDuration@ seconds. Critical strikes add 2 additional stacks. Each stack grants @MSPercent*100@% Move Speed.

During this time, {{Spell_ZeriQ_Name}} becomes a faster triple shot that chains @ChainPhysicalDamage@ physical damage to nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The Attack Speed also increases Zeri's max Attack Speed. The chain lightning can critically strike but does not apply On-Hit effects. Uncharged Attacks do not stack or refresh this ability.
This ability's duration extension cannot exceed its original duration of @RDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has increased Move Speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zeri fires an electric pulse that slows and damages the first enemy hit. If the pulse hits a wall it expands into a long range laser.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zeri fires an electric pulse that deals @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Slows the first enemy hit by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

If the pulse hits terrain, it expands into a laser that applies the effects in an area and Critically Strikes champions and monsters for @WallDamage@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability's cast time scales down with Attack Speed.
Empowered damage scales with Critical Strike Damage at @CriticalEffectiveness*100@% effectiveness.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kids from the Undercity stick together.
